lines.label: West

facts.text: Snow left Virginia Lakes Ridge (9,400 ft) 16 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 11; earlier seasons: July 1 (2023), May 25 (2024), May 27 (2025)

facts.text: At Virginia Lakes Ridge (9,400 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 7.0 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: 7.0 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 54.4 in (2023), 16.9 in (2024), 16.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 22 and June 10, carried from the melt-out dates at Vogelsang (10,095 ft) and Virginia Lakes Ridge (9,400 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Vogelsang
evidence.detail: melted out May 15, 152 ft above the pass; points to April 20 to June 4

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out May 11, 543 ft below the pass; points to April 25 to June 15
